**Learning rate (2e-4) is the one I'd change.** The script's own comment says it: 2e-4 is the "quick demo" LoRA rate. For a full-epoch distillation run where you actually care about quality, 5e-5–1e-4 is a better range — 2e-4 with linear decay over a whole epoch tends to wash out nuance in the teacher traces early and can destabilize tool-call formatting. If your dataset is large (tens of thousands of rows), lean toward the lower end.
